title: Barney: Individuation as Engineering — Immutable Core, Executable Verification, and Portable Mechanisms for Guarded Body Growth
description: Barney is a self-developing LLM agent with an immutable Immune Core and a Plastic Body that grows through executable verification (ZPD-3 proofs), an experience-write law opened by prediction error, and a Four-Hand transfer protocol measuring body-causal transfer (ΔS). The kernel is immutable; the body lives in ~/.barney. This preprint accompanies the v0.4.0 code release and contains the Russian and English PDFs of the paper.
